name: AI Analysis Evasion
description: Instructions or bait placed inside an artefact — malware, a package, a document, an advert, a web page — and addressed to the AI that will inspect it, so that an AI-based scanner, reviewer or analyst returns a clean verdict, skips the artefact or stops. Also reported as "AI evasion".
differs: Adversarial Evasion (T7.002) perturbs an input to shift a classifier's decision; this addresses the analysing model in plain language. Detection & Attribution Evasion (T9.002) hides activity inside the victim's own AI system; this targets the defender's AI tooling. The payload is usually a prompt injection (T1.001 or T1.002) and may rely on Induced Refusal (T6.002).
